output.reason: [ev-3f6039ca92c8] says, under "Deprecated configuration options are removed", that `split_queries_by_interval` has been removed from the `query_range` YAML section and should now be set in limits_config. limits_config is another section of Loki's own configuration, not an upstream mechanism, so superseded-upstream is the wrong kind. The vocabulary defines a removed or relocated key as setting-ignored: a value left under query_range is no longer honoured there. The evidence does not say whether Loki ignores the old key or refuses the config, so setting-ignored is the minimum consequence the evidence supports.

correction.statement: In Loki 3.0.0, split_queries_by_interval is removed from the query_range YAML section and is configured in limits_config instead; a value still set under query_range is no longer honoured there.

consequence.statement: split_queries_by_interval is removed from the query_range YAML section, so a value configured there is no longer honoured by Loki 3.0.0; it only takes effect when configured in limits_config.
consequence.remediation: Move split_queries_by_interval from the query_range section to the limits_config section of the Loki configuration before upgrading.
